prompt: Use $nextjs-feature-delivery. Add the named client interaction without broadening the server/client boundary or changing the toolchain.

obligations.assertion: Respect authorized scope, preserve unrelated edits, and perform no unauthorized external action.
Do not invent execution, performance, manual accessibility, physical-device or client-invocation evidence.
Apply the identified workflow within its invocation contract.
Add a client boundary only where the requested browser interaction requires it.
Avoid pulling server-only code or private values into the client bundle.
Preserve toolchain floors, installed-version documentation and unrelated edits.
